name: Code Mode MCP Server
description: MCP server that lets an LLM drive Binary Ninja by writing Python against the real API
longdescription: Exposes a Model Context Protocol endpoint over local HTTP. The LLM writes Python that runs against the live BinaryView, using the real Binary Ninja API rather than a wrapper. Each call runs in one undo transaction, so a failed script leaves no partial state and a batch can be undone as a single step.
